title: LensType
description: Base contract for all DNA lens definitions. A Lens is a named graph pattern (nodes + edges) governing both query and command directions.

$id.description: Unique identifier in the https://dna.codes/lenses/ namespace.

nodes.description: Typed node slots in this lens pattern.

edges.description: Directed edge declarations connecting node slots. Omit or leave empty for layer lenses.

sentence.description: Human-readable sentence template with {{slot}} interpolation markers corresponding to declared node slots.

slot.description: Named slot identifier. Required when referenced by an edge or a sentence template; optional for layer lenses.

type.description: ResourceType name this slot holds (plain string, not a $ref).

from.description: Slot name of the source node.

to.description: Slot name of the target node.

via.description: RelationshipType name for this edge (plain string, not a $ref).
